# ---- The second bench (doc 48, section 4) ----
# The Workshop tile is done and gnomes are the primary heritage (a kept heritage keeps the hall, not the bench).
DA_GN_has_bench = {
	DA_RH_primary_gnomish = yes
	has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Workshop
}
DA_GN_commission_running = {
	has_country_flag = DA_GN_bench_busy
}
# A commission can start: the bench holds no study and no commission.
DA_GN_bench_free = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_bench_open_tt
		DA_GN_has_bench = yes
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_bench_free_tt
		NOT = { DA_GN_commission_running = yes }
		NOT = { DA_SCH_studying_any = yes }
	}
}
# Patents can run: an active gnomish heritage, the Artificers estate and artificery (Anbennar).
DA_GN_patents_allowed = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_active_tt
		DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
	}
	has_estate = estate_artificers
	DA_SS_artificery_available = yes
}

# ---- The lead school (doc 48, section 5.1) ----
DA_GN_org_brillite = {
	has_estate_privilege = estate_artificers_organization_international_gommo
}
DA_GN_org_mechanist = {
	has_estate_privilege = estate_artificers_organization_independent_unions
}
DA_GN_org_thaumaturge = {
	has_estate_privilege = estate_artificers_organization_state
}
DA_GN_org_other = {
	NOT = { DA_GN_org_brillite = yes }
	NOT = { DA_GN_org_mechanist = yes }
	NOT = { DA_GN_org_thaumaturge = yes }
}
# The organization decides; under any other organization the charter's pick; Grand Synthesis can override.
DA_GN_lead_brillite = {
	has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Lead_School
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override.brillite
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override }
			DA_GN_org_brillite = yes
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override }
			DA_GN_org_other = yes
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_pick.brillite
		}
	}
}

	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_up_missing_tt
		NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.coils.1 }
	}
	DA_completed.Magic_Theory_3 = yes
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_inno_tt.5
		OR = {
			AND = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Synthesis innovativeness = 4 }
			innovativeness = 5
		}
	}
	DA_GN_bench_free = yes
	treasury = 300
}

	has_country_flag = DA_GN_engine_built
	DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
}

		tooltip = DA_GN_synthesis_tt
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Synthesis
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_engine_once_tt
		NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_engine_built }
		NOT = { DA_GN_st_bench_engine = yes }
	}
	DA_GN_bench_free = yes
	treasury = 3000
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_mat_tt.metal.100
		check_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 100 }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_mat_tt.building.50
		check_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 50 }
	}
}

# ---- Gommo Branches (doc 48, section 6.5). The diplomatic action DA_GN_open_branch: ROOT is our country, FROM the
# country that would host the branch. A host carries DA_GN_branch_<our tag> (DA_GN_branch_pending_<tag> while it
# is on our bench). ----
DA_GN_branch_target_ok = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_ally_tt
		FROM = { OR = { alliance_with = ROOT is_subject_of = ROOT } }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_branch_none_tt
		FROM = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_@ROOT }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_pending_@ROOT }
		}
	}
}
DA_GN_can_branch = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_needs_branches_tt
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Branches
	}
	DA_GN_bench_free = yes
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_branch_max_tt
		NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_branch_count value = 3 } }
	}
	treasury = 500
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_mat_tt.building.10
		check_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 }
	}
}

# ---- Licences (doc 48, section 6.5). The diplomatic action DA_GN_license_patent: ROOT is our country, FROM the
# country that would take the licence. A licensee carries DA_GN_lic_<patent>_<our tag>. ----
DA_GN_lic_target_ok = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_ally_tt
		FROM = { OR = { alliance_with = ROOT is_subject_of = ROOT } }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_lic_any_tt
		OR = {
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cocolocogram
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_cocolocogram_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.recuverinator
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_recuverinator_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.dynamos
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_dynamos_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.bombards
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_bombards_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.crammers
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_crammers_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.spyglass
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_spyglass_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.monocles
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_monocles_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.looms
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_looms_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cranes
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_cranes_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.tugs
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_tugs_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.walking
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_walking_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.ledgers
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_ledgers_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.arcades
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_arcades_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.bulkheads
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_bulkheads_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.lenses
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_lenses_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.lockers
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_lockers_@ROOT } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.coils
				FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_coils_@ROOT } }
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_GN_can_license = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_needs_international_tt
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_International
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_active_tt
		DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_GN_lic_max_tt
		NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_lic_count value = 3 } }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_pending }
	}
}
# A country that holds at least one of our licences (in its scope; ROOT is our country).
DA_GN_holds_our_licence = {
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_cocolocogram_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_recuverinator_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_dynamos_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_bombards_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_crammers_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_spyglass_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_monocles_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_looms_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_cranes_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_tugs_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_walking_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_ledgers_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_arcades_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_bulkheads_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_lenses_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_lockers_@ROOT
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_coils_@ROOT
	}
}

# ---- The E++ Patent Dispute (doc 48, section 9): a goblin neighbour with E++ (Anbennar's E++ Compound) ----
DA_GN_eplus_goblin = {
	DA_RH_primary_goblin = yes
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = unlocked_artifice_invention_eplusplus_compound
		has_estate_privilege = artifice_invention_eplusplus_compound
	}
}
DA_GN_eplus_ready = {
	NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_eplus_done }
	has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Patent_Office
	DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
	any_neighbor_country = { DA_GN_eplus_goblin = yes }
}
